ModMetaData.name: Android Subroutines Expanded
ModMetaData.author: Based on Android Subroutine Extension BETA by Equanimity
ModMetaData.description:
This mod adds a total of 69 new subroutines, with both advantages and disadvantages. The goal of this mod is to make the android creation process deeper and more interesting, as well as introducing new mechanics to the game.
After adding the mod, 4 new categories will appear at the very bottom of the android editor menu. Since some new subroutines consume large amounts of energy, it is recommended to install one of the new generation reactors. The more energy you want, the stronger the negative effects will be, so you'll have to find a balance.
Compatible with RimWorld 1.6 and requires VRE Android and Vanilla Expanded Framework.
